newsitem.title: CHINA: China Erfangji sets up jv with Barmag.
newsitem.headline: China Erfangji sets up jv with Barmag.

text.p: A Sino-German joint venture between Shanghai Erfangji Co Ltd and Barmag has gone into production making fibre spinning machine production lines, an Erfangji official said on Wednesday.
Shanghai Erfangji holds 49 percent of the total investment of $6.5 million, with Barmag holding 51 percent, he said.
He said 40 complete chemical fibre spinning machine production lines would be made annually.
"About 60 percent of the total products will be exported, and that will become a new profit source and help improve our 1997 earnings," the official said.
He declined to give further details.
Erfangji's foreign currency B shares ended Wednesday at $0.186, up $0.008 or 4.49 percent, and its domestic A shares rose 0.16 yuan 2.36 percent to 6.95 yuan.
